description: Biasing prompt handed to the recognizer, written as example transcriptions rather than a description. Large Whisper models imitate the style of their prompt as well as its vocabulary, so this primes clinical terms the model would otherwise replace with common English, and digits spelled out as words -- the form the chart reads. Measured on the replay recordings with large-v3 it raised chart accuracy from 66% unprompted to 94%. Shared by the browser lexicon and the Python recognizer; tests/lexicon.test.ts fails if a prompt-marked term is missing, and scripts/bakeoff.py measures this exact text.
